title: Checks for usage of Vec<Box<T>> where T.
summary: Sized anywhere in the code. Check the Box documentation for more information. Vec already keeps its contents in a separate area on the heap. So if you Box its contents, you just add another level of indirection. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for calls to push immediately after creating a new Vec.
summary: The vec![] macro is both more performant and easier to read than multiple push calls. Clippy puts this lint in the perf group, at the level warn.

title: Finds occurrences of Vec::resize(0, an_int)
summary: This is probably an argument inversion mistake. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.

title: Checks for bit masks that can be replaced by a call to trailing_zeros
summary: x.trailing_zeros() >= 4 is much clearer than x & 15 == 0 Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for usage of File::read_to_end and File::read_to_string.
summary: fs::{read, read_to_string} provide the same functionality when buf is empty with fewer imports and no intermediate values. See also: fs::read docs, fs::read_to_string docs Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
